quest.title: Promises Remembered as Lanterns Rise
quest.description: Wangshu Inn's chef, Smiley Yanxiao, seems to have a lot on his plate right now...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I have to hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is business that good?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: No. But it's the Lantern Rite now. Lots of people have headed back to the city to spend the festive period there, so we're short-staffed. I'm basically doing everything myself.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: We're not getting too many guests, though, so things aren't too bad. I can still handle it.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: *cough* Also, I should thank you for helping me previously. If it hadn't been for your help, I don't think I'd ever have been able to return to work...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: N—No! Definitely not, believe me! I—If she were to show up again, I d—don't know if my heart could take it...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: If you really want to ask about... her... you should just go ask the boss. I—I don't know anything, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Traveler! How can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Dusky Ming...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Oh, her? She's been quite well-behaved since that incident.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: But I do feel bad for that child. Whenever a festive period rolled along in the past, she'd get lonelier as the inn grew livelier. As a result, she would wind up starting trouble and scaring the guests.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: But I'm sure that she just wants someone to play with her. She is only a child, after all.

choices.text: Can we send her a Xiao Lantern?

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: You want to send her a Xiao Lantern? That's not a bad idea. The only trouble is that she's quite hard to find...

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: If you're looking for her, you should hang a Xiao Lantern atop one of the trees in the nearby forest at night.

response.speaker: Verr Goldet
response.text: That way, she should be able to see it.

choices.text: I wonder if she'd like a Xiao Lantern...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: Well, did you deliver the Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I guess... we can consider it sent.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I believe so, too. This should cheer her up a bit at least.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: I wonder, what sort of wish would that child make?

talks.objective: Head to the woods near Wangshu Inn

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you really want to ask about... her... you should just go ask the boss. I—I don't know anything, I swear...

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: If you're looking for her, you should hang a Xiao Lantern atop one of the trees in the nearby forest.

dialogues.speaker: Verr Goldet
dialogues.text: That way, she should be able to see it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the place. Wonder where she is...

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. You're here to play with me!

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: Hehe, did you remember what I said last time?

dialogues.speaker: Dusky Ming
dialogues.text: Well then, let's play... hide and seek.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Do we really have to go...

talks.objective: Hang the Xiao Lantern on a treetop
